Publish.LongDescription:
# 🛻🏕️🛣️ ## Parks, Roads + Lane Wear Control park maintenance, road repair trucks, and the rate of road wear.
**调整公园维护、道路维修车辆和道路磨损速度。** 🇨🇳 简体中文 ↓
### Adjust
- **Park maintenance:** depot fleet size, work capacity, and work rate. - **Road maintenance:** depot fleet size, work capacity, and repair rate. - **Lane wear:** roads deteriorate slower or faster. 0% stops road wear and recalls unneeded repair trucks. Damaged roads make vehicles drive slower. Trucks still clear accidents normally.
Each feature is optional. **100% = normal game default.**
## Good to know - **Lightweight:** no in-city UI bloat. - **Set it and forget it.** Settings apply once, then the mod sleeps. - Safe to remove anytime. All vanilla, no Harmony patches means more reliable on game patch days. - See the in-game Options tooltips for details (hover any row, see 3rd panel, right side).
## Support and Feedback * Support by clicking Like 👍 (top right), no donations requested, just a free like. * For feedback, use the [Discord](https://discord.gg/gwXgvtyhjc) | [Github](https://github.com/River-Mochi/CS2-Parks-Roads) links on this page. PRs are welcome, GPL-3.0 license.
## Credits - River-Mochi — mod author - Thumbnail photo by [nps.gov Yellowstone Park Renovation](https://www.nps.gov/yell/getinvolved/planning.htm)
### Compatibility - Snowy Roads mod: Snow visuals still work at 0%, but snowplow clearing may be limited when road maintenance dispatches are reduced, suggest 5% or higher on lane wear slider. - Some park and road features were originally in [All Transit + Trucks mod](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/138390/Windows). This standalone mod keeps them separate and simple.

## 🚜 公园与道路维护 · 自由控制道路损坏
### 主要功能
- **公园维护：** 调整车库车辆上限、工作量和工作速度。 - **道路维护：** 调整车库车辆上限、工作量和维修速度。 - **道路磨损：** 调整磨损速度。**0% 停止磨损并召回不必要的维修车。** 道路损坏会使车辆减速，任何磨损设置下都能正常处理事故。
功能可独立设置，**100% = 游戏默认值**。
### 使用须知
- **轻量高效：** 不增加城市内 UI 负担；设置应用后即休眠。 - **安全兼容：** 本模组可随时卸载，使用游戏原生机制，无 Harmony 补丁，降低游戏更新后的兼容风险。 - **Snowy Roads（积雪道路）：** 0% 仍显示积雪，但除雪车可能不出动。建议 **5% 或以上**（不保证派车）。 - **详细说明：** 游戏选项中悬停任意设置，查看右侧第三栏。
👍 喜欢请点右上角的赞！无需捐款。欢迎通过 [Discord](https://discord.gg/gwXgvtyhjc) 或 [GitHub](https://github.com/River-Mochi/CS2-Parks-Roads) 反馈，也欢迎提交 PR（GPL-3.0）。
Publish.ChangeLog: - Player request filled: reduced slider from 5% limit to 0% option to allow no wear. - Auto recalls trucks assigned to obsolete road repairs, reducing unnecessary traffic. - Accident response not affected. - Suggest setting road wear to at least 5% or more if using the Snowy Roads mod. - updated all translations for tooltips.
